description: Walks every screen in the flow and lists the interface assets they need: icons, frames, nine-slices, fonts, cursors, per-state variants. Produces a list, never the images.
when_to_use: the request is 'what UI assets are still missing'
screens are shipping with placeholder interface art
a UI generation run needs a list to work from
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the images
the question is what the screens should do rather than what art they need
inputs: the ui style guide when there is one
outputs: UI asset checklist with gaps marked
